notes.heading: Placements
notes.text: Each part stands by a feature it carries, as gripper_assembly.scad's header records; the tool interface stack under it, with both XL-320s, is ../900-ToolInterface/tool_assembly.scad's.

notes.heading: Where the servos and the printed parts disagree
notes.text: The Span Driver stands where the pinion's drive slot puts it, which is not where the span XL-320's spline would seat it; gripper_assembly.scad's header gives why it cannot simply be moved. The spline's length is assumed (../c102_servo.scad), so this waits on a measurement of a servo. In mm:
